title: The Golden Scooter's Final Secret! 🛴
topic: The resolution of the scooter theft accusation.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: EVERYONE LOOK! NIX FINALLY ADMITTED [beat] HE STOLE THE GOLDEN SCOOTER!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You really think I’m that stupid, Bruno? [beat] I didn't steal it, I intercepted it before you could sell it for parts!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: My custom scooter was worth five thousand dollars! [beat] Nix, if you have it, you better start talking right now or I'm calling the cops!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Uncle Jamal, just look inside your garage. [beat] The scooter isn't gone, it's actually fully restored and better than when you bought it!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: He’s lying! I saw him pushing it down the alley at midnight! [beat] He’s just a common thief trying to play the hero!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I was pushing it to the repair shop [beat] because I saw you kicking it over and snapping the brake lines yesterday afternoon, Bruno!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Wait... the security footage shows Nix [beat] spending his entire allowance on new ceramic bearings and custom paint for my birthday?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I didn't want to say anything, but seeing Bruno try to frame me [beat] forced my hand. I just wanted to do something nice for once.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You're pathetic! Doing all that work for free? [beat] In this world, money is the only thing that matters, you loser!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Actually, Bruno, since Nix saved my scooter, I’m giving him the reward money [beat] and I'm letting him decide what happens to you.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I’m not calling the police. [beat] I’m just making you clean every single scooter in the neighborhood for a whole month.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix proved [beat] that in this world, kindness is the only currency that actually buys you a completely clean slate.
